what: the reader validation sample: the army count and the owner colour of selected countries, read by looking at the frames
selection: measurements/sample-selection.json (seeded random frames and countries, chosen without looking at the reader)
measurements/sample-selection-notices.json (frames under a notice, found by the screens module, a second stratum so that hidden numerals are in the sample)
measurements/sample-selection-anchors.json (T40 round 2, R3: the measured-only anchors 11 and 15 on six new seeded random frames, two per sitting; labelled by eye before the reader was run on them)
method: each reading was labelled from a 3x zoomed crop of the frame around the country, before the reader was run on the sample; a numeral drawn in cyan is labelled with its digits like a white one; visible is false when a notice, its text or its edge covers the numeral, wholly or in part
